nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the base metadata URI for the collection; writable only through setMetaURI (onlyOwner).
Mapping(address=>uint256) binding a whitelisted address to its reserved tokenId; written by addWhite/removeWhite and read by _getTokenId.
Mapping(address=>string) storing the per-address image fragment used to build token metadata; written by addWhite/removeWhite, read by _getImg.
Address of the OpenSea ProxyRegistry used by isApprovedForAll to whitelist delegate proxies.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of meta-transaction nonces; read to build the MetaTransaction and incremented after signature verification to prevent replay.
Boolean initialization guard used by the initializer modifier guarding _initializeEIP712.
Public unpermissioned mint entry point: mints a reserved token to _msgSender().
onlyOwner setter that replaces the base metadata URI, requiring a non-empty string.
onlyOwner batch whitelist that maps addresses to reserved tokenIds and image strings in a bounded loop (<=500 entries).
onlyOwner function clearing a whitelisted address entry, only allowed while its reserved tokenId is unminted.
Internal view resolving the caller/recipient address to its reserved tokenId, reverting when unset.
Internal view returning the image fragment for the current owner of a tokenId.
Public view returning the current value of metaURI as the base URI.
Public view building a base64 data-URI JSON metadata payload from the tokenId, base URI and image fragment.
Payable meta-transaction relayer entry point: validates an EIP-712 signature, bumps the nonce, then low-level calls address(this) with the user-supplied function signature.
Internal signature check recovering the signer via ecrecover over the typed message hash; acts as the access-control gate for meta-transactions.
Overridden approval query that grants implicit approval to the owner's OpenSea proxy registered in proxyRegistryAddress.
Internal mint routine validating destination and non-existence, then updating _balances and _owners.
Internal mint helper resolving the reserved tokenId for the recipient and minting it.
Caller-controlled address used as the effective sender (via _msgSender/ContextMixin) and as the relayer for meta-transactions.
Low-level address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) executing arbitrary attacker-supplied calldata.
Arithmetic update nonces[userAddress] = nonces[userAddress].add(1) performed after signature verification.
Arithmetic state update _balances[to] += 1 inside ERC721._mint.
Arithmetic state update _balances[from] -= 1 inside ERC721._transfer.
Unbounded-per-element loop counter arithmetic and array indexing over caller-sized calldata arrays in addWhite.
Assembly that reads the last 20 bytes of msg.data as the sender when msg.sender == address(this), allowing sender spoofing through appended calldata (meta-transaction path).
Private owner address backing onlyOwner checks on setMetaURI/addWhite/removeWhite.
Private counter initialized to zero in ERC721Tradable2 (sequence base for token ids).
Private hook performing an external IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received call on contract recipients during safe transfers/mints.
Mapping(address=>uint256) tracking token balances; mutated by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
Recipient address parameter of mintTo/_mintTo, derived from _msgSender() in mintByUser.
Calldata string parameter carrying the new base URI in setMetaURI.
Calldata address array of whitelist targets in addWhite.
Calldata uint256 array of reserved token ids in addWhite.
Calldata string array of image fragments in addWhite.
Address parameter identifying the whitelist entry to clear in removeWhite.
User/signer address parameter of executeMetaTransaction.
Arbitrary bytes parameter of executeMetaTransaction forwarded into the low-level self-call.
ECDSA signature r value parameter of executeMetaTransaction.
ECDSA signature s value parameter of executeMetaTransaction.
ECDSA signature v value parameter of executeMetaTransaction.
Loop index local used to iterate over the whitelist arrays in addWhite (and string concatenation loops).
Local MetaTransaction struct built from nonces[userAddress], userAddress and functionSignature.
Local variable holding the result of _getTokenId(_to) inside _mintTo.
Local address returned by ERC721.ownerOf(tokenId) within _getImg/owner lookups.
Local string result of baseTokenURI() inside tokenURI.

edges.reason: mintByUser uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the mint recipient, letting any caller trigger a mint to themselves.
The caller address resolved by _msgSender() flows into the _to recipient parameter.
mintByUser invokes _getTokenId to resolve the reserved token id before minting.
mintByUser delegates the actual minting to the internal _mintTo helper.
_mintTo calls ERC721._mint(to, newTokenId) to create the token.
The token id resolved by _getTokenId is stored in the local newTokenId.
local newTokenId is produced by _getTokenId(_to).
_getTokenId reads the reserved id from attrTokenids[_to].
The recipient parameter is used as the lookup key inside _getTokenId.
_getImg reads the image fragment from attrImgs[ownerOf(_tokenId)].
setMetaURI writes the new base URI into the metaURI state variable.
The _metaURI calldata parameter is validated and stored.
addWhite iterates the addrs parameter and writes whitelist entries.
addWhite reads tokenIds[i] for each address.
addWhite reads imgs[i] for each address.
addWhite assigns attrTokenids[addrs[i]] = tokenIds[i].
addWhite assigns attrImgs[addrs[i]] = imgs[i].
addWhite drives the loop counter arithmetic and calldata array indexing over up to 500 elements.
The loop index local i feeds the increment/multiply arithmetic in the addWhite loop.
removeWhite uses the addr parameter as the whitelist key to clear.
removeWhite resets attrTokenids[addr] to zero.
removeWhite clears attrImgs[addr].
baseTokenURI returns the metaURI state variable.
tokenURI calls baseTokenURI() while assembling metadata.
tokenURI calls _getImg(_tokenId) to embed the image fragment.
The base URI returned by baseTokenURI is held in the local baseURI.
executeMetaTransaction uses userAddress as the meta-transaction signer and nonce key.
The provided functionSignature is forwarded verbatim into the self-call.
sigR is consumed by the signature verification step.
sigS is consumed by the signature verification step.
sigV is consumed by the signature verification step.
The MetaTransaction struct local metaTx is assembled from caller-supplied arguments.
executeMetaTransaction reads nonces[userAddress] to build the meta-transaction.
The nonce read from state flows into the increment operation.
The incremented nonce value is written back into the nonces mapping.
executeMetaTransaction is gated by verify(), whose ecrecover result must match userAddress; a flawed/low-s signature check would bypass authorization.
executeMetaTransaction performs a low-level address(this).call with attacker-controlled calldata, enabling arbitrary internal function invocation and reentrancy.
The relayer address from msg.sender is emitted and used as the payable relayer in the meta-transaction event.
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress to query the owner's delegate proxy and grant implicit approval to it.
msg.sender is compared to address(this) and, in the self-call path, the effective sender is read from the tail of msg.data, allowing sender identity spoofing.
_mint updates the _balances mapping for the recipient.
The recipient balance is incremented by one during minting.
The sender balance is decremented by one during transfer, an arithmetic state update.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external onERC721Received call on a contract recipient, which can reenter the token contract mid-transfer (classic ERC721 receiver callback).

normalization_plan.reason: The attacker-supplied calldata is forwarded directly into the low-level self-call operation.
Loop index local exists only to drive the addWhite iteration arithmetic.
